Chapter 6008: Phantom Domain

Chapter 6008: Phantom Domain

“Splendor Terra is breached, its destruction all but assured. Isn’t it the time to flee, Fellow Daoists?” Ghost-eyed Desolate God smiled at Goldvase Angel and the manager.

“Its destruction is assured? How, when we’re still alive?” The manager sneered.

Both regular disciples and desolate gods remained loyal to Splendor Terra, something rather surprising to the attackers. After all, Splendor Terra wasn’t a sect but more of a marketplace. Merchants normally came and went.

“Have it your way then.” Ghost-eyed didn’t waste time: “We will take down this fortress and divide its treasures.”

“Take down the fortress! Divide its treasures!” Some attackers chanted.

Splendor’s wealth was no secret in Sin but none dared to attack it in the past, let alone make it this far. Everything changed with the destruction of the outer barrier and the disappearance of Unrivalled Monarch.

“Activate the imperial formation.” The manager gave the order. They had no other option or reinforcement and could rely only on themselves to stop the horde.

Morale remained high since no disciple wanted to leave, preparing for a fight to the death.

“Rumble!” Dao laws appeared around the fortress and gathered to form a grand momentum and formation.

“Boom!” Goldvase and the manager melted and joined this newly created formation. A pillar of light pierced the sky vault, looking as if a supreme existence was within.

“Splendor Imperial Formation.” Ghost-eyed had a serious expression.

“Heavenblade Dominion!” The manager roared and summoned an energy blade brimming with chaos energy and imperial laws.

“A creation of Splendor Monarch.” Many became startled.

“Phantom Domain!” Ghost-eyed held a banner, summoning a massive city with countless banners to block the blade.

“Bam!” Cracks appeared in the city upon contact to the astonishment of the crowd.

Ghost-eyed was far stronger than the manager and Goldvase yet their formation could overcome the difference in cultivation.

“No wonder why Splendor Terra was never afraid even with the big transactions.” Someone said.

“Look at how many refined jades are on that fortress, no other sect can muster this.” A new desolate god entered the battlefield.

Two desolate gods and numerous survivors empowered this formation. However, another big reason was the incalculable number of refined jades. This was the power of money.

“But, the fortress will still fall today.” The desolate god sneered.

“The Ouyang Clan Master, another ten-fruit desolate god.” Many recognized him.

“Rising Sun!” He roared and summoned a sun with both hands.

“Splendor Citadel!” The fortress had no choice but to revert to a defensive stance, creating heavenly citadels all around.

“Boom!” The sun struck the citadels and caused violent quakes.

“Utmost Limit!” Ghost-eyed made his move, waving his banner and releasing a fiery beam at the citadels.

“Count me in, try this slash!” A Grand Emperor appeared with an aura freezing the crowd.

“Ironthorn Grand Emperor!” Everyone knew his title.

“Immortal Suppression is joining now.” Spectators took a deep breath.

“Rumble!” The sky was torn asunder by the combined might of two desolate gods and a three-fruit emperor.

Although the formation of Splendor Fortress was mighty, cracks finally appeared.

“It’s only a matter of time.” Sky Step King commented.

“It’s incredible that they have lasted this long.” Minisun praised.

“Buzz.” Another figure appeared in the sky, robbing the world of its light and sounds.

Time seemingly came to a stop as his aura overwhelmed everything. Ghost-eyed, Ouyang Clan Master, and Ironthorn all stopped and watched the old man.

He had an impressive figure looking like an uncrossable mountain. Dragon roars emanated majestically from him.

“Dragonform Grand Emperor!” The crowd recognized this influential figure.
